sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the grossTonnage >= 500 applicability condition and the distinct same-ship independence check. Repair the power-connection constraints: connectedToMainPower and connectedToEmergencyPower have supplied canonical domains of benchmarkEntity, but the requirement and authoritative requiredOwner require these facts to be owned by each nonMagneticHeadingMeans. The candidate therefore places the properties on an incompatible owner and targets benchmarkEntity as their value class.
